sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal mature face, short brown temple hair under a tall dark navy-black textured fur hat with raised/folded uneven top lobes and central gold laurel/red badge. Separate thin brown eyebrows, neutral small closed mouth, bare chin; tiny upper-lip shading does not establish a distinct moustache at156x210. Dark navy jacket with plain lapels, bright white pointed shirt and black necktie. Chest-up crop on full pale cream-grey painted backing, soft upper-left light; tiny hat badge relief is pixel-limited.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Three-quarter mature face angled up toward screen left, short slicked dark hair visible on screen right under a brown folded side cap with small red-gold badge. Dark chin/goatee hair extends along mouth corners and across chin with lighter salt shading; upper lip much lighter and tiny stubble versus shade is uncertain, do not add a large heavy moustache. Separate brows, relaxed slightly smiling mouth, a long thin brown pipe stem touches it while the raised screen-left hand holds the bowl/pipe close to the face. Dark teal scarf wrapped around neck, blue-grey double-breasted-style broad coat lapels and dark inner knit cloth. Keep actual raised hand and pipe pose/crop, head-up direction and soft upper-left light; complete cream-grey backing.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Three-quarter mature face toward screen right, short wavy side-parted light brown hair, brown eyebrows and a clearly separate neat dark moustache plus small pointed dark soul patch directly below lower lip; remaining chin/cheeks smooth. Dark navy jacket with broad lapels, white pointed shirt and large blue bow tie with visible folded loops. Calm small closed mouth, chest-up crop and soft screen-left light on complete pale cream-grey painted backing. No hat or eyewear; preserve the bow tie rather than a necktie, tiny hair/fabric texture is pixel-limited.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Three-quarter mature face toward screen right, short wavy side-parted light brown hair, separate brown brows, neat dark moustache and small pointed soul patch beneath lower lip, otherwise smooth jaw/chin. Black/charcoal jacket with thin light piping along lapels, white pointed shirt and dark grey patterned conventional necktie. Calm closed mouth, shoulder/chest crop and soft light from screen left on full pale cream-grey backing. No hat or eyewear; this is the necktie outfit, do not replace it with the bow tie of another portrait. Tiny tie pattern strokes remain pixel-limited.
